credential.oauthHelp: the authorization produces the token; it is not pasted by hand. It will be stored at this level, so shared with every member — and it will act on behalf of the account you sign in with at the provider. Prefer a service account to a personal one: actions will be attributed to it, and the connection will survive its holder leaving. Granting it again lets you change it.
